course.title: Laptop Repair
course.tagline: Diagnose and fix laptops: screens, keyboards, storage and software faults.

days.title: Laptop Parts and Tools
days.goal: Know the parts inside a laptop and the tools to open one safely.

video.title: EASY! How to Add More RAM to Laptop

steps: Lay out precision screwdrivers, plastic pry tools, tweezers and a mat.
Learn the parts: battery, RAM (memory), SSD (storage drive), fan and motherboard.
The motherboard is the main board everything plugs into.
Find the screws on the bottom and learn some hide under rubber feet.
days.task: Draw and label the inside of a laptop.
days.challenge: Name five parts inside a laptop without looking.

quiz.q: What is RAM in a laptop?
options: Short-term memory the laptop uses while working
quiz.explain: RAM is fast short-term memory; more RAM lets a laptop do more at once.

quiz.q: What is an SSD?
options: A fast storage drive that keeps your files
quiz.explain: An SSD stores your files and programs, and is much faster than an old hard drive.

quiz.q: Why add more RAM to a slow laptop?
options: It lets the laptop run more programs at once without slowing down
quiz.explain: More RAM stops the laptop swapping to slow storage when you open many programs.

days.title: Safety: Power Off and Static
days.goal: Work safely: power off, unplug and beat static.

video.title: EASY! How to Add More RAM to Laptop

steps: Shut the laptop down fully, not sleep, and unplug the charger.
Remove the battery if you can.
Touch a metal object first to discharge static (the tiny shock that can kill chips).
Work on a hard table, not on carpet.
days.task: Write your own five safety rules for laptop work.
days.challenge: Open a laptop safely with no static damage.

quiz.q: How should you shut a laptop down before you open it?
quiz.explain: Shut the laptop down fully, not sleep, before you open it.

quiz.q: Why touch a metal object before you work inside a laptop?
options: To discharge static that can kill chips
quiz.explain: Touch a metal object first to discharge static, the tiny shock that can kill chips.

quiz.q: Where should you work on a laptop?
quiz.explain: Work on a hard table, not on carpet.

days.title: Add More RAM
days.goal: Add memory (RAM) so a slow laptop runs faster.

video.title: EASY! How to Add More RAM to Laptop

steps: Check how much RAM the laptop has and what type it needs.
Power off, unplug and open the bottom panel.
Find the RAM slot, line up the notch and push the stick in at an angle.
Press it down until the clips click, then close up and test.
days.task: Add RAM to a laptop and check it shows up in settings.
days.challenge: Add RAM in under 15 minutes.

quiz.q: What should you check before you add RAM?
options: How much RAM the laptop has and what type it needs
quiz.explain: Check how much RAM the laptop has and what type it needs.

quiz.q: How do you fit a RAM stick?
options: Line up the notch and push it in at an angle
quiz.explain: Find the RAM slot, line up the notch and push the stick in at an angle.

quiz.q: How do you know the RAM is fitted right?
quiz.explain: Press it down until the clips click, then close up and test.

days.title: Check RAM and Storage
days.goal: Check how much memory and storage a laptop has.

video.title: How to Change Your Laptop Battery

steps: Open Settings and find the RAM amount.
Check the storage: how much is used and how much is free.
Learn the difference: RAM is short-term memory, storage keeps your files.
Decide if the laptop needs more RAM or a bigger drive.
days.task: Check RAM and storage on three laptops and record the results.
days.challenge: Tell a RAM problem from a storage problem by the symptoms.

quiz.q: Where do you check how much RAM a laptop has?
quiz.explain: Open Settings and find the RAM amount.

quiz.q: What is the difference between RAM and storage?
options: RAM is short-term memory, storage keeps your files
quiz.explain: RAM is short-term memory, storage keeps your files.

quiz.q: How do you decide if a laptop needs more RAM or a bigger drive?
options: Check what is full: memory or storage
quiz.explain: Check how much is used and how much is free, then decide.

days.title: Change a Laptop Battery
days.goal: Replace a worn laptop battery safely.

video.title: How to Change Your Laptop Battery

steps: Power off and unplug, then open the bottom panel.
Unplug the battery cable from the motherboard first.
Remove the screws holding the battery and lift it out.
Fit the new battery, plug it in and test charging.
days.task: Replace a laptop battery in a practice laptop.
days.challenge: Replace a battery without bending it.

quiz.q: What should you unplug first when you change a battery?
options: The battery cable from the motherboard
quiz.explain: Unplug the battery cable from the motherboard first.

quiz.q: What holds the battery in place?
quiz.explain: Remove the screws holding the battery and lift it out.

quiz.q: What should you test after you fit a new battery?
quiz.explain: Fit the new battery, plug it in and test charging.

days.title: Battery Health and Swollen Batteries
days.goal: Spot a bad battery and handle a swollen one safely.

video.title: How to Change Your Laptop Battery

steps: Check battery health with a battery report.
Learn the signs: fast drain, trackpad lifting, case bulging.
A swollen battery is a fire risk: stop and handle it with care.
Never poke or bend a swollen battery.
days.task: Run a battery report and explain what the numbers mean.
days.challenge: Spot a swollen battery and explain the danger.

quiz.q: What should you do first when changing a laptop battery?
options: Power off, unplug and open the panel
quiz.explain: Power off and unplug first, then open the laptop safely.

quiz.q: What is a sign of a swollen battery?
quiz.explain: A swollen battery pushes the case and trackpad up from inside.

quiz.q: Why never poke a swollen battery?
quiz.explain: Puncturing a lithium battery can cause fire and toxic smoke.

days.title: Project: Replace a Laptop Keyboard
days.goal: Replace a faulty laptop keyboard from start to finish.

video.title: How to Replace HP ProBook Keyboard

steps: Power off, unplug and remove the battery.
Open the bottom, unplug the keyboard cable.
Remove the old keyboard and fit the new one.
Reconnect, close up and test every key.
days.task: Finish a laptop with a working new keyboard.
days.challenge: Replace the keyboard with no leftover screws.

quiz.q: What should you unplug first inside a laptop?
quiz.explain: Unplugging the battery first cuts all power to the board.

quiz.q: What is a ribbon cable latch?
options: A small clip that holds a flat cable in place
quiz.explain: Ribbon cables use a flip-up latch; lift it gently, never pull the cable.

quiz.q: Why test every key after a keyboard swap?
options: To catch any key that does not work before you hand it back
quiz.explain: Testing every key catches a loose cable before the customer finds it.

project.title: Replace a Laptop Keyboard
project.brief: Replace a faulty laptop keyboard from start to finish.

days.title: Keyboard Cables and Clips
days.goal: Handle the small ribbon cables that join the keyboard.

video.title: How to Replace HP ProBook Keyboard

steps: Learn that keyboard cables use a flip-up latch, not force.
Lift the latch gently with a plastic tool.
Slide the cable out straight, never at an angle.
Slide the new cable in fully, then close the latch.
days.task: Unplug and reconnect a keyboard cable without damage.
days.challenge: Reconnect a cable first try with no bent pins.

quiz.q: How do you open a keyboard cable latch?
options: Lift it gently with a plastic tool
quiz.explain: Keyboard cables use a flip-up latch: lift it gently with a plastic tool.

quiz.q: Which way do you slide a ribbon cable out?
quiz.explain: Slide the cable out straight, never at an angle.

quiz.q: What should you do after you slide a new cable in?
quiz.explain: Slide the new cable in fully, then close the latch.

days.title: Test Every Key
days.goal: Test a keyboard fully after a repair.

video.title: How to Replace HP ProBook Keyboard

steps: Open an online keyboard tester in the browser.
Press every key and watch it light up on screen.
Check the space bar, shift keys and function keys.
Fix any key that does not register by reseating its cable.
days.task: Test a keyboard and record any key that fails.
days.challenge: Find one dead key and fix it by reseating the cable.

quiz.q: What do you use to test a keyboard after a repair?
quiz.explain: Open an online keyboard tester in the browser.

quiz.q: Which keys should you check carefully?
options: Space bar, shift keys and function keys
quiz.explain: Check the space bar, shift keys and function keys.

quiz.q: How do you fix a key that does not register?
quiz.explain: Fix any key that does not register by reseating its cable.

days.title: Disassemble a Laptop Safely
days.goal: Take a laptop apart in order and keep every screw safe.

video.title: Asus Vivobook S15 S5507 Disassembly

steps: Photograph the bottom before you remove any screw.
Remove screws in order and keep them sorted on your mat.
Pry the bottom panel gently with a plastic tool.
Never force a panel: a hidden screw is usually the cause.
days.task: Take a laptop apart and put it back together working.
days.challenge: Find a hidden screw instead of forcing a panel.

quiz.q: Why photograph the bottom before disassembly?
options: So you know where every screw goes
quiz.explain: A photo shows the screw positions for reassembly.

quiz.q: What do you do if a panel will not come off?
options: Look for a hidden screw under a foot or sticker
quiz.explain: A stuck panel usually means a hidden screw is still in place.

quiz.q: Where do laptop screws often hide?
quiz.explain: Makers hide screws under feet and stickers to keep the bottom clean.

days.title: Find Parts Inside
days.goal: Find the RAM, SSD, Wi-Fi card, fan and battery inside any laptop.

video.title: Asus Vivobook S15 S5507 Disassembly

steps: Open the laptop and point to each part.
Learn that the SSD is the storage drive and the Wi-Fi card is small with two wires.
Find the fan and the copper heat pipes that cool the processor.
Draw a map of the parts for that model.
days.task: Draw a parts map for one laptop model.
days.challenge: Find the SSD in any laptop in under a minute.

quiz.q: What is the SSD in a laptop?
quiz.explain: The SSD is the storage drive.

quiz.q: How can you tell which part is the Wi-Fi card?
options: It is small with two wires
quiz.explain: The Wi-Fi card is small with two wires.

quiz.q: What cools the processor?
options: The fan and copper heat pipes
quiz.explain: Find the fan and the copper heat pipes that cool the processor.

days.title: Clean Dust and Fans
days.goal: Clean dust from fans and vents so a laptop runs cool.

video.title: Asus Vivobook S15 S5507 Disassembly

steps: Power off and open the laptop.
Hold the fan still with a toothpick so it cannot spin.
Blow dust out with short bursts of compressed air.
Clean the vents and close up, then check the temperature.
days.task: Clean a dusty laptop and record the temperature drop.
days.challenge: Clean a fan without breaking a blade.

quiz.q: Why hold the fan still while you clean it?
quiz.explain: Hold the fan still with a toothpick so it cannot spin.

quiz.q: How should you blow dust out of a laptop?
options: In short bursts of compressed air
With a vacuum on full power
quiz.explain: Blow dust out with short bursts of compressed air.

quiz.q: What should you check after you clean the fans?
quiz.explain: Clean the vents and close up, then check the temperature.

days.title: Replace an ASUS Keyboard
days.goal: Replace an ASUS laptop keyboard step by step.

video.title: How to Replace ASUS K55V Laptop Keyboard | Step-by-Step DIY Repair Guide

steps: Power off, remove the battery and the bottom cover.
Unplug the keyboard ribbon cable carefully.
Remove the old keyboard assembly.
Fit the new keyboard, reconnect and test every key.
days.task: Replace an ASUS keyboard in a practice laptop.
days.challenge: Replace the keyboard and keep every screw sorted.

quiz.q: What should you remove before you change an ASUS keyboard?
options: The battery and the bottom cover
quiz.explain: Power off, remove the battery and the bottom cover.

quiz.q: What cable should you unplug carefully?
quiz.explain: Unplug the keyboard ribbon cable carefully.

quiz.q: What should you do after you fit the new keyboard?
quiz.explain: Fit the new keyboard, reconnect and test every key.

days.title: Soldered Keyboards and Rivets
days.goal: Know when a keyboard is glued or riveted in and what to do.

video.title: How to Replace ASUS K55V Laptop Keyboard | Step-by-Step DIY Repair Guide

steps: Some keyboards are held by melted plastic rivets, not screws.
Learn to cut the rivets carefully and replace them with small screws.
Work slowly: rushing breaks the keyboard frame.
Know when to tell a customer the job needs a full top case.
days.task: Explain riveted keyboards to a customer in plain words.
days.challenge: Remove a riveted keyboard without cracking the frame.

quiz.q: What holds some keyboards in place instead of screws?
quiz.explain: Some keyboards are held by melted plastic rivets, not screws.

quiz.q: What should you replace cut rivets with?
quiz.explain: Cut the rivets carefully and replace them with small screws.

quiz.q: When should you tell a customer the job needs a full top case?
options: When the keyboard is riveted in and too hard to fix alone
quiz.explain: Know when to tell a customer the job needs a full top case.

project.title: Full Keyboard Swap on a Practice Laptop
project.brief: Do a complete keyboard replacement on a practice laptop.

days.title: Project: Full Keyboard Swap on a Practice Laptop
days.goal: Do a complete keyboard replacement on a practice laptop.

video.title: How to Replace ASUS K55V Laptop Keyboard | Step-by-Step DIY Repair Guide

steps: Power off, open the laptop and unplug the battery.
Remove the old keyboard fully.
Fit the new keyboard and reconnect all cables.
Test every key and close the laptop up neatly.
days.task: Finish a full keyboard swap with every key working.
days.challenge: Complete the swap with no leftover parts.

quiz.q: What is the first step in a full keyboard swap?
options: Power off, open the laptop and unplug the battery
quiz.explain: Power off, open the laptop and unplug the battery first.

quiz.q: What should you do after you remove the old keyboard?
options: Fit the new keyboard and reconnect all cables
quiz.explain: Fit the new keyboard and reconnect all cables.

quiz.q: How do you finish a keyboard swap?
options: Test every key and close the laptop up neatly
quiz.explain: Test every key and close the laptop up neatly.

days.title: Overheating: Why Laptops Get Hot
days.goal: Learn why laptops overheat: dust, old paste and blocked vents.

video.title: HP Victus – Complete Disassembly and Thermal Paste Replacement | How to Reduce Laptop Temperature

steps: Feel the vents: hot air should flow out freely.
Check the fan spins and is not clogged with dust.
Learn that thermal paste (a cream that moves heat from the chip to the cooler) dries out.
Check temperatures with a free monitoring app.
days.task: Check the temperature of a laptop and explain if it is normal.
days.challenge: Tell dust overheating from paste overheating by the signs.

quiz.q: What should you feel at the vents of a hot laptop?
quiz.explain: Feel the vents: hot air should flow out freely.

quiz.q: What happens when thermal paste dries out?
quiz.explain: Thermal paste dries out and stops moving heat, so the laptop overheats.

quiz.q: How can you check laptop temperatures?
quiz.explain: Check temperatures with a free monitoring app.

days.title: Clean the Cooling System
days.goal: Clean the heatsink and fan so a laptop cools properly.

video.title: HP Victus – Complete Disassembly and Thermal Paste Replacement | How to Reduce Laptop Temperature

steps: Power off, open the laptop and unplug the battery.
Remove the fan and clean it with air and a soft brush.
Blow dust out of the heatsink fins (the thin metal slats).
Put it back together and check the temperature drops.
days.task: Clean a cooling system and record the temperature before and after.
days.challenge: Clean a heatsink without bending the fins.

quiz.q: What should you clean the fan with?
quiz.explain: Remove the fan and clean it with air and a soft brush.

quiz.q: What are heatsink fins?
quiz.explain: Blow dust out of the heatsink fins, the thin metal slats.

quiz.q: How do you know the cleaning worked?
quiz.explain: Put it back together and check the temperature drops.

days.title: Replace Thermal Paste
days.goal: Replace dried-out thermal paste on the processor.

video.title: HP Victus – Complete Disassembly and Thermal Paste Replacement | How to Reduce Laptop Temperature

steps: Remove the heatsink screws in the numbered order.
Lift the heatsink off gently.
Clean off the old paste with alcohol and a cloth.
Put a rice-sized drop of new paste on the chip and refit the heatsink.
days.task: Replace thermal paste and check the temperature drops.
days.challenge: Apply the right amount of paste: not too much, not too little.

quiz.q: What is thermal paste?
options: A cream that moves heat from the chip to the cooler
quiz.explain: Thermal paste fills tiny gaps so heat flows from the chip into the heatsink.

quiz.q: How much thermal paste should you use?
quiz.explain: A rice-sized drop spreads thin and even when the heatsink presses down.

quiz.q: Why replace old thermal paste?
options: It dries out and stops moving heat, so the laptop overheats
quiz.explain: Dried paste cannot transfer heat, so the processor gets hot and slows down.

days.title: Replace a Laptop Screen
days.goal: Replace a cracked laptop screen step by step.

video.title: How to Replace a Broken Laptop Screen

steps: Power off, unplug and remove the battery.
Remove the bezel (the frame around the screen) with a plastic tool.
Unscrew the screen, unplug its cable and lift it out.
Fit the new screen, plug it in, test it, then refit the bezel.
days.task: Replace a laptop screen in a practice laptop.
days.challenge: Replace the screen with no damage to the bezel clips.

quiz.q: What do you use to remove the bezel?
quiz.explain: Remove the bezel, the frame around the screen, with a plastic tool.

quiz.q: What should you do before you lift the old screen out?
options: Unscrew it and unplug its cable
quiz.explain: Unscrew the screen, unplug its cable and lift it out.

quiz.q: When should you refit the bezel?
options: Before you test the new screen
After you fit and test the new screen
Before you remove the old screen
quiz.explain: Fit the new screen, plug it in, test it, then refit the bezel.

days.title: Test a New Screen
days.goal: Test a new screen before you finish the job.

video.title: How to Replace a Broken Laptop Screen

steps: Connect the new screen loosely and power on.
Check for dead pixels (tiny dots that stay black or white).
Check brightness, colours and the webcam.
Only then screw everything back together.
days.task: Test a new screen fully before sealing the laptop.
days.challenge: Catch a faulty new screen before the laptop is closed.

quiz.q: What is the bezel of a laptop screen?
quiz.explain: The bezel is the plastic frame that holds the screen in the lid.

quiz.q: Why test a new screen before reassembly?
options: To catch a faulty screen before the laptop is sealed
quiz.explain: Testing first means you never seal a bad screen inside a laptop.

quiz.q: What is a dead pixel?
options: A tiny dot on the screen that stays black or white
quiz.explain: Dead pixels are tiny screen dots that never light up correctly.

days.title: Project: Replace a Laptop Screen
days.goal: Replace a cracked screen from start to finish.

video.title: How to Replace a Broken Laptop Screen

steps: Power off, open the laptop and unplug the battery.
Remove the bezel and the broken screen.
Fit the new screen and test it before reassembly.
Refit the bezel and test again.
days.task: Finish a laptop with a working new screen.
days.challenge: Replace the screen with no leftover screws.

quiz.q: What is the first step to replace a laptop screen?
options: Power off, open the laptop and unplug the battery
quiz.explain: Power off, open the laptop and unplug the battery first.

quiz.q: When should you test the new screen?
quiz.explain: Fit the new screen and test it before reassembly.

quiz.q: What should you do last when you replace a screen?
options: Refit the bezel and test again
quiz.explain: Refit the bezel and test again.

project.title: Replace a Laptop Screen
project.brief: Replace a cracked laptop screen from start to finish.
checks: Display clear with no dead pixels

days.title: Fix a Single Broken Key
days.goal: Fix one broken laptop key without replacing the whole keyboard.

video.title: How to Repair a Laptop Key

steps: Pry the key cap off gently with a plastic tool.
Check the small scissor clip underneath is not broken.
Clean under the key and reseat the cap.
Replace just the key cap if the clip is fine.
days.task: Fix one broken key so it types normally.
days.challenge: Fix a key without breaking its clip.

quiz.q: What is the first check for a keyboard that does not work?
options: Test it in the BIOS startup screen
quiz.explain: If keys work in BIOS, the fault is software; if not, it is hardware.

quiz.q: How do you fix one broken laptop key?
options: Lift the key cap, check the clip, clean and reseat it
quiz.explain: Most single-key faults are a dirty or unseated key cap and clip.

quiz.q: What is a scissor clip under a key?
options: The small folding clip that holds the key cap
quiz.explain: The scissor clip is the tiny folding part that lets the key press down.

days.title: Keyboard Not Working: Software First
days.goal: Check software before you blame the keyboard hardware.

video.title: How to Repair a Laptop Key

steps: Test the keyboard in the BIOS (the startup screen) first.
If it works there, the fault is software: reinstall the driver.
Check the Filter Keys setting is off.
Try an external USB keyboard to prove the laptop still works.
days.task: Prove a keyboard fault is software, not hardware.
days.challenge: Fix a keyboard by reinstalling its driver.

quiz.q: Where should you test a keyboard first?
quiz.explain: Test the keyboard in the BIOS, the startup screen, first.

quiz.q: If the keyboard works in BIOS, what is the fault?
quiz.explain: If it works there, the fault is software: reinstall the driver.

quiz.q: What setting should you check is off?
quiz.explain: Check the Filter Keys setting is off.

days.title: Touchpad Problems
days.goal: Fix a touchpad that does not respond.

video.title: How to Repair a Laptop Key

steps: Check the touchpad is switched on with its function key.
Reinstall the touchpad driver.
Clean the touchpad surface.
Test with an external mouse to prove the laptop works.
days.task: Fix a touchpad that does not respond.
days.challenge: Tell a driver fault from a hardware fault.

quiz.q: What should you check first if a touchpad does not respond?
options: That it is switched on with its function key
quiz.explain: Check the touchpad is switched on with its function key.

quiz.q: What should you do if the touchpad driver is faulty?
quiz.explain: Reinstall the touchpad driver.

quiz.q: How can you prove the laptop still works with a dead touchpad?
quiz.explain: Test with an external mouse to prove the laptop works.

days.title: Laptop Will Not Turn On
days.goal: Diagnose a laptop that will not start.

video.title: Dell Laptop Not Turning On Diagnosis

steps: Check the charger and the charging light first.
Hold the power button for 15 seconds to drain leftover power.
Test with the battery removed, charger only.
Reseat the RAM: loose memory stops a laptop starting.
days.task: Diagnose a laptop that will not turn on.
days.challenge: Find the cause of a no-start laptop in ten minutes.

quiz.q: What is the first check for a laptop that will not turn on?
options: Check the charger and charging light
quiz.explain: A dead charger is the most common cause of a no-start laptop.

quiz.q: What does the external monitor test prove?
options: Whether a black screen is the screen or the board
quiz.explain: A picture on a TV means the board works and the laptop screen is faulty.

quiz.q: Why reseat the RAM on a laptop that will not start?
options: Loose memory can stop a laptop from starting
quiz.explain: RAM that is not seated properly stops the laptop completing startup.

days.title: External Monitor Test
days.goal: Use a TV or monitor to test if a black screen is the screen or the board.

video.title: Dell Laptop Not Turning On Diagnosis

steps: Plug the laptop into a TV with an HDMI cable.
If the TV shows a picture, the laptop screen or cable is faulty.
If the TV stays black, the fault is deeper: RAM or board.
Press the display switch keys to send the picture out.
days.task: Use an external monitor to prove where a black-screen fault is.
days.challenge: Tell a screen fault from a board fault with one test.

quiz.q: How do you connect a laptop to a TV for the monitor test?
quiz.explain: Plug the laptop into a TV with an HDMI cable.

quiz.q: If the TV shows a picture, what is faulty?
quiz.explain: If the TV shows a picture, the laptop screen or cable is faulty.

quiz.q: If the TV stays black, what is the fault?
options: A deeper fault: RAM or board
quiz.explain: If the TV stays black, the fault is deeper: RAM or board.

days.title: Upgrade Storage to SSD
days.goal: Swap a slow hard drive for a fast SSD.

video.title: Dell Laptop Not Turning On Diagnosis

steps: Back up all files first.
Clone the old drive to the new SSD, or install Windows fresh.
Swap the drives and screw the SSD in.
Boot up and enjoy the faster laptop.
days.task: Upgrade a laptop from hard drive to SSD.
days.challenge: Clone a drive so no files are lost.

quiz.q: Why back up files before swapping a drive?
options: So no files are lost if the swap goes wrong
quiz.explain: A backup means your files survive even if the new drive fails.

quiz.q: What is cloning a drive?
options: Copying the whole old drive onto the new one
quiz.explain: Cloning copies everything, so the new drive works exactly like the old one.

quiz.q: Why is an SSD faster than a hard drive?
options: It has no moving parts and reads data instantly
quiz.explain: SSDs read data with no moving parts, so they are far faster than spinning disks.

days.title: Install Windows Fresh
days.goal: Install Windows on a new drive from a USB stick.

video.title: A Framework For A Repairable Future

steps: Make a Windows USB installer on another computer.
Boot the laptop from the USB stick.
Follow the setup screens and pick the right drive.
Install drivers from the maker website after setup.
days.task: Install Windows fresh on a practice laptop.
days.challenge: Install Windows and all drivers with no errors.

quiz.q: What do you need to install Windows fresh?
quiz.explain: Make a Windows USB installer on another computer.

quiz.q: How do you start the laptop for a fresh install?
quiz.explain: Boot the laptop from the USB stick.

quiz.q: What should you install after Windows setup?
quiz.explain: Install drivers from the maker website after setup.

days.title: Capstone Planning
days.goal: Choose your capstone repair, order the part and plan the day.

video.title: A Framework For A Repairable Future

steps: Pick a laptop with a real fault to fix for a real person.
Order the exact part for that laptop model.
Write a step-by-step plan with testing at each stage.
Tell the owner the price and time before you start.
days.task: Have the part ordered and the repair plan written.
days.challenge: Plan a capstone repair that uses screen, keyboard or storage skills.

quiz.q: What laptop should you pick for your capstone?
options: One with a real fault to fix for a real person
quiz.explain: Pick a laptop with a real fault to fix for a real person.

quiz.q: What part should you order for the capstone repair?
options: The exact part for that laptop model
quiz.explain: Order the exact part for that laptop model.

quiz.q: What should you tell the owner before you start?
quiz.explain: Tell the owner the price and time before you start.

days.title: Capstone: Repair a Real Laptop
days.goal: Repair a real laptop for a real person and hand it back working.

video.title: A Framework For A Repairable Future

steps: Repair the laptop following your plan, testing as you go.
Test screen, keyboard, battery, storage and Wi-Fi.
Clean the laptop inside and out.
Hand it back with your price list and warranty note.
days.task: Hand back a repaired laptop with all functions working.
days.challenge: Finish the repair with time left for a full test.

quiz.q: How should you repair the capstone laptop?
